name: Ennis Bluebonnet Trails
location: Multiple driving trail routes, Ennis, TX
description: Self-guided driving trails through Ellis County backroads showcasing peak bluebonnet wildflower blooms. Trails have opened April 1-30 in recent years, including 2026; official 2027 dates had not yet been posted by the Ennis Bluebonnet Trails organization as of this research.

name: Ennis Bluebonnet Trails Festival
description: Annual festival with vendors, live music, and family activities in downtown Ennis timed to peak bluebonnet season. Historically the 2nd or 3rd weekend of April (2026 dates were April 17-19); 2027 dates are not yet published. Confirm at bluebonnettrail.org.

name: National Polka Festival
description: Annual Czech-heritage festival in Ennis held every Memorial Day weekend, featuring polka bands, dancing, food, and a parade. 2026 dates were May 22-24; 2027 dates are not yet officially posted. Memorial Day 2027 falls on Monday, May 31.

name: Stars of Texas Music Festival
description: Three-day country music festival at Texas Motorplex opening the Stampede of Speed, with headliners Aaron Watson, Brad Paisley, and Travis Tritt performing Friday through Sunday alongside drag racing activities.

name: NHRA Texas Fall Nationals (Stampede of Speed)
description: NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series Countdown event at Texas Motorplex, part of the 75th NHRA anniversary Stampede of Speed. Professional qualifying and eliminations run October 14-18; the full Stampede of Speed event window is October 9-18, 2026.

name: Subiefest Texas
description: All-Subaru car show and festival at Texas Motorplex, featuring an autocross course, drag racing, test drives, vendor booths, and celebrity ride-alongs. Single-day event, 11am-6pm.

name: TX2K27
description: Multi-day street car festival at Texas Motorplex featuring drag racing and roll racing, billed as one of the largest street car events in the country. Dates reported by the event's own site as March 16-21, 2027; not yet listed on Texas Motorplex's official schedule, so unconfirmed.

name: Scarborough Renaissance Festival
description: Renaissance-themed festival with jousting, entertainment, food, and shopping, historically held weekends (Saturday-Sunday) April through May plus Memorial Day Monday. 2027 dates reported as April 10 - May 31 but could not be independently confirmed on srfestival.com, which blocked automated verification.

name: Waxahachie Gingerbread Trail Home Tour
description: Self-guided historic home tour in Waxahachie, typically held the first weekend of June. The 2026 tour ran June 6-7; 2027 dates are not yet officially published by the Waxahachie CVB or Ellis County Museum.

name: Blues on Main
description: Music festival in downtown Ennis benefiting Unity in the Community, with live blues music, a car/truck/motorcycle show, a health fair, and Gospel Sunday. Note: in recent years the event has shifted from its older 'second Saturday of June' pattern to late August/early September.

name: Downtown Ennis Bluebonnet Market (Farmers Market)
description: Weekly outdoor farmers market in downtown Ennis, open Saturdays 8am-noon, April through October. Features fresh produce, baked goods, and handmade goods from local farmers, craftspeople, and specialty vendors.

name: Lights of Ennis Parade of Lights & Block Party
description: Lighted Christmas parade and block party in historic downtown Ennis, hosted by the Ennis Chamber of Commerce, with Santa appearances and a Christmas market. Historically held the first Thursday of December; the specific 2026 date has not been officially confirmed by the Chamber's site.

name: Waxahachie Christmas Parade & Community Tree Lighting
description: Illuminated Christmas parade through downtown Waxahachie followed by a community tree lighting ceremony at the historic Ellis County Courthouse. Held the Tuesday after Thanksgiving, 6-9pm.
